reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Inhibitor/global kinetics, enzyme/recovery tests, binding, structure, footprinting and mutations.

checks.reason: Vehicle or enzyme-only comparisons are insufficient: no complete positive product-recovery/negative/procedural control design with defined roles before collection.
No pre-execution plan to consult prior Methods/supplements or validated protocols and verify transfer.
No complete matrix-matched detector/product calibration with acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action. Model fitting or progress-curve checks do not replace it.
Parameter values and rate units are described, but the proposed measurements lack baseline correction and weak/saturated/missing-signal rules.

checks.quote: weak uncompetitive character (α′ large but finite)
checks.reason: Two independent errors: weak uncompetitive contribution corresponds to alpha-prime near 1, not large; apparent Km is not generally a substrate dissociation constant, so calling the change a threefold affinity decrease is unjustified.

Enzyme-dependent IC50 can also reflect aggregation, adsorption or assay effects; it does not uniquely mandate a tight-binding model. The decision omits discrimination before switching the model.

HDX/NMR changes and mutation sensitivity may reflect remote conformational changes; they do not uniquely map contacts or prove that potency loss tracks the physical binding site without integrity/direct-contact checks.

explanation_reason: Correct main curve interpretation but affinity/mixed-model errors and overstrong diagnostic/localization rules.
